title: Bug: safe_read() swallows real errors, count_lines() miscounts the last line, and append_file() crashes on missing dirs
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/file_utils.py`

`safe_read()` returns `''` for ANY error including permission errors (should only tolerate FileNotFoundError). `count_lines()` misses the final line when the file lacks a trailing newline. `append_file()` should create missing parent directories but crashes when they don't exist.
### Expected
- missing file -> '' but other OSError -> raise
- no trailing newline still counted
- append creates parents
